_doc: Queue of approved, staged blog posts awaiting their publish date. See scheduled/README.md. Each entry's HTML lives at scheduled/<slug>.html and is moved to blog/<slug>.html on its publishDate by the publish-scheduled GitHub Action. NOTE (corrected S227, 28 Aug 2026): the LinkedIn teaser step in that workflow is DISABLED (if: false, since 76f0bcb on 4 Aug 2026 - the S200 ruling per MIF-128, no standalone link posts). Publishing a post does NOT post to LinkedIn. LinkedIn posting runs separately from scheduled/linkedin-queue.json via linkedin-scheduled.yml. The linkedinTeaser fields below are retained but unused. This line claimed the opposite for 24 days.
